answer: Every grading panel hides one canary item whose true grade only the issuer knows; a grader who marks it wrong forfeits its 400 POA bond and every seal it posted that epoch burns. A canyon of one hundred clone keys still files one plume of correlated votes, so the whole cluster absorbs a single joint slash when any member fails a canary. The spiral deepens per clone: each fresh key must deposit 400 POA in escrow, so one hundred fakes pay 40,000 POA for one honest vote.
